name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + battle domain + descriptor accurately reflects purpose (composite-pass left-edge clip offset) and scalar 'offset' type. No Ghidra address residue (suffix is not 53aed). No domain ID to preserve. Confirmed against live Ghidra symbol name.
purpose: Per-frame X clip offset added into the battle tile-map composite source byte offset to clip the extra leftmost margin column drawn during the left-walk smooth-scroll animation.
logic_summary: fd2_walk_step_left sets this to 0x18 (24px = one tile column) immediately before each of its 6 per-frame fd2_composite_battle_tile_map calls (which render a +1-column-wide, left-shifted window via win_origin_x-1, 0xE cols) and clears it to 0 right after the call, so outside the left-walk animation it is 0. fd2_composite_battle_tile_map reads it as a dword in all three background-source branches (animated chapters @0x11FC1, extra-wide parallax chapters @0x1207E, chapter 0x17 text-screen @0x120E3) and ADDs it directly into the background-blit source byte offset, immediately alongside the sub-pixel offset @0x53AF5. Net effect: shift the background source right by 24px so the clipped leftmost column is not displayed during the slide-in.
element_semantics: Scalar 32-bit byte-offset (range observed {0, 0x18}); 0x18 = 24px = one 24px tile column, 0 = no clip (static state).
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but slightly imprecise: it said the value is added 'alongside the sub-pixel/parallax offsets', whereas the read actually adds it directly next to the sub-pixel offset (@0x53AF5) only -- the parallax row offset (@0x53AF1) is scaled by 0x1C8 separately, not added on the same expression. Also did not state it is mutable BSS / dword for consistency with sibling globals in the same file.
notes: Verified via disassembly of fd2_composite_battle_tile_map (read sites 0x11FC1/0x1207E/0x120E3: ADD EAX,[0x53AED]) and fd2_walk_step_left (write sites 0x130A6 set 0x18, 0x130E9 set 0). Memory @0x53AED is all zeros (BSS). Live Ghidra symbol name and datatype (dword) confirmed via run_script_inline. Ghidra plate already detailed and consistent with refined understanding, so left unchanged. Name rename NOT applied (Stage 2). Only the symbol's own comment block in aniwalk.c was edited (via Edit).
